content: AXChartDescriptorRepresentable protocol requires makeChartDescriptor() -> AXChartDescriptor. AXChartDescriptor is constructed with title, summary, xAxis (AXCategoricalDataAxisDescriptor or AXNumericDataAxisDescriptor), yAxis, additionalAxes, and series: [AXDataSeriesDescriptor]. Attached to a chart view via .accessibilityChartDescriptor(_:) modifier, which supersedes per-mark accessibilityLabel for VoiceOver's audio-graph experience.
